# skill_dashboard_conventions

The rules of the status page `module_monitoring` serves: one static page of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript and its toolkit, the names of its scripts and classes, how it shows a number, the state it keeps and the arithmetic it may do, what it reads and by which path, and the one server of three prefixes that serves it on loopback. How to extend the page is `module_monitoring/README_module_monitoring.md` § Extending.

## Architecture

- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-ONE-SERVER-OF-THREE-PREFIXES`
  - Description: One server, `module_monitoring/serve.py`, serves the page and the two stores it reads under three prefixes and nothing else: the page's own files under `/`, the status store under `/status/`, the run-records store under `/run_records/`.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/serve.py`, `module_monitoring/config.py`
  - Expected: `STORE_DIR_BY_ROUTE_PREFIX` the two store prefixes; a page file served only as a direct child of `MODULE_MONITORING_DIR` with a suffix of `PAGE_FILE_SUFFIXES`, `/` answered with `PAGE_INDEX_FILE_NAME`; every other path and every directory a 404, and no route of the page's own; a change of the prefixes moving, in the same commit, `serve.py`'s docstring, `module_monitoring/README_module_monitoring.md` and the mapping table of `module_skills/README.md`.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-THE-PAGE-READS-BY-RELATIVE-PATH`
  - Description: The page names every file it reads by a path relative to itself, under `status/` or `run_records/`, so it reads the same files wherever it is served and knows no host, port or absolute path.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`, `module_monitoring/index.html`
  - Expected: `status/<snapshot>.json`, `run_records/index.json` and `run_records/<run_id>/<record>` for the records the index lists; no scheme, host, port or leading `/` in a path the page fetches or links.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-PRESENTATION-ARITHMETIC-ONLY`
  - Description: The page computes no domain or model result: it renders what a snapshot or a run record holds, with presentation arithmetic over those values alone.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`
  - Expected: A share of two published counts (`realDataPct`, `buildShareCell`), a mean over the validation folds (`mean` over `validationFolds`), a difference of two reported metrics (the holdout degradation, the delta against the active state), a sum over a record's entries (`bytesWritten`), an age against the browser's clock (`ageCell`); no label, fit, model metric or strategy number computed in a script.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-TWO-STATE-GLOBALS`
  - Description: The page keeps two state globals — `ML_STATUS` and `FEATURES_STATUS` in `ml.js` — the snapshots it holds after their fetch because more than one tab renders from them; the data snapshot, the crawl snapshot and the run records are rendered as they arrive and held nowhere.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`
  - Expected: A file-scope `let` for those two alone and a `const` for every other file-scope binding; `PILL_HOOKS`, the pill-hook registry of `page.js`, a registry and not state; a new state global entering this rule in the commit that adds it.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-REACHABLE-ON-LOOPBACK-ONLY`
  - Description: The page is reachable on the host's loopback alone: the server binds every interface of its container's own namespace, compose publishes it on `127.0.0.1` only, and a remote reader comes through an SSH tunnel, never through a bind on a public interface of the host.
  - Scope: `docker-compose.yml`, `module_monitoring/config.py`
  - Expected: `BIND_ADDRESS` every interface of the container's namespace and `CONTAINER_PORT` its side of the mapping; the `dashboard` service's one port mapping `127.0.0.1:${PORT}` onto `CONTAINER_PORT`; the tunnel `ssh -N -L` of `README.md`.
  - Exception: none

## Naming

- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-FILE-SCOPE-FUNCTIONS-TAKE-A-CLOSED-VERB`
  - Description: A JavaScript name is native lowerCamelCase, and a function at file scope takes its verb from a closed list — `build`, `render`, `format`, `append`, `select`, `init`, `fetch` — while one that returns a quantity or a descriptor carries none.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`
  - Expected: `build<Object>` returning a node, `render<Section>` writing into the page, `format<Value>` turning a value into text, `append<Child>` mutating a parent, `select<Target>`, `init<Component>`, `fetch<Object>` returning a promise; `mean`, `validationFolds`, `millisecondsSinceEpoch` for a quantity or a descriptor — the JavaScript row of the grammar table in `AGENTS.md`.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-A-DOMAIN-OBJECT-IS-NEVER-A-ONE-LETTER-ALIAS`
  - Description: A domain object — an asset, a payload, a strategy block, a record — is named for what it is and never a one-letter alias, and a boolean answers a question.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`
  - Expected: `asset`, `status`, `record`, `finalHoldoutStrategy`; `isWarning`, `isFinalHoldout`.
  - Exception: Equation and geometry locals inside one tight kernel, as the coordinates of `buildSparkline`.
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-CSS-CLASSES-FOLLOW-BEM`
  - Description: A CSS class follows BEM — `block`, `block__element`, `block--modifier` — and is named for what it marks; a single-class utility block stays one class.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.css`, `module_monitoring/**/*.js`, `module_monitoring/**/*.html`
  - Expected: `frame__head`, `meter__fill`, `spark__base`, `pill--active`, `final-holdout`; the utilities `box`, `foot`, `warn`, `err` and `invariant` one class each, combined on an element rather than suffixed.
  - Exception: none

## Workflow

- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-A-TAB-MOVES-EVERY-LIST-OF-THE-TABS`
  - Description: A tab added, renamed or removed changes, in the same commit, every document that lists the tabs.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/index.html`, `README.md`, `module_monitoring/README_module_monitoring.md`, `module_skills/skill_glossary.md`
  - Expected: The tabs of the `data-pills="tab"` nav of `index.html`, in their order and by their labels, named alike by `README.md` (its quickstart and its Dashboard section), by the tab's row in `module_monitoring/README_module_monitoring.md` and by the register wherever it lists them.
  - Exception: none

## FileLayout

- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-TOOLKIT-WRITES-NO-SECTION`
  - Description: What the page's sections share lives in the toolkit, `page.js`, which writes into no section's element.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`
  - Expected: `page.js` loaded first, holding the one parser of the UTC text a payload carries (`millisecondsSinceEpoch`), the formatters, cells, tables, frames and pills; it names no element id of `index.html` and touches only the generic structure its components carry (`[data-pills]`, `[data-panel]`).
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-A-SECTION-OWNS-ITS-FILE`
  - Description: A section owns its script and the elements it renders, and no other file writes them.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`, `module_monitoring/index.html`
  - Expected: One script per tab family — `data.js`, `ml.js`, `asset.js`, `features.js`, `run.js`, `scalability.js` — each element id of `index.html` filled by one of them alone; `ml.js`, which fetches the two ML snapshots, filling the envelope box of each tab that reads them.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-EVERYTHING-SHIPS-HERE`
  - Description: Every file the page needs ships inside this module's directory; what it reads is the stores', served beside it.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/`
  - Expected: `index.html`, `style.css` and the section scripts direct children of `module_monitoring/`, the only files `serve.py` serves under `/`; no file of the page in another module or in a store.
  - Exception: none

## UI_TUI

- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-ONE-STATIC-PAGE`
  - Description: The dashboard is one static page of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with no framework and no build step.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.html`, `module_monitoring/**/*.js`, `module_monitoring/**/*.css`
  - Expected: Files served as they are written: no framework, bundler, transpiler, package manifest or linter.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-NO-EXTERNAL-RESOURCE`
  - Description: The page loads nothing from outside the tree — no font, no CDN, no tracker — so it renders with no network but its own.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.html`, `module_monitoring/**/*.js`
  - Expected: Every stylesheet, script and file the page loads a path of this module or of its two stores; the system's monospace font; every chart an SVG built inline.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-THE-DESKTOP-VIEWPORT-IS-THE-ONLY-TARGET`
  - Description: The page is laid out for a desktop viewport alone.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.css`, `module_monitoring/**/*.html`
  - Expected: No media query and no viewport meta element; the body held to one maximum width in `style.css`.
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-MAGNITUDES-ARE-BARS-NOT-COLOURS`
  - Description: A magnitude is shown as a bar, never as a colour: colour marks a category and bold marks the final holdout's row.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`, `module_monitoring/**/*.css`
  - Expected: `buildMeter` beside the number for a share or a size; `.warn`, `.invariant` and `.err` the colours, each a category; `.final-holdout` the bold; a sparkline an inline SVG with a dashed reference line (`.spark__base`).
  - Exception: none
- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-AN-INVARIANT-IS-MARKED-BY-ITS-HEADER`
  - Description: On the data views every cell of a column whose only correct value is zero — an invariant of `module_data/skills/skill_candle_canonicalisation.md` — is marked `invariant`, so a reader tells the numbers to be alarmed by from the observations a change of provider is expected to move; such a column is named by its header, never counted by position.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/data.js`, `module_monitoring/style.css`
  - Expected: `VENUE_INVARIANT_HEADERS` and `CANONICAL_INVARIANT_HEADERS` in `data.js`, read by `renderInvariantColumns`; `.invariant` declared before `.warn` in `style.css`, so a broken invariant reads as a warning.
  - Exception: none

## Scalability

- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-A-SECTION-BUILDS-ONE-PART-PER-MEMBER`
  - Description: A section with as many parts as a payload has members builds them from the payload and names none, so a provider or an asset added to the pipeline changes no file of this module.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`, `module_monitoring/index.html`
  - Expected: `data.js` building one frame, one column and one share cell per entry of the snapshot's `source_venues`; one pill of the ML Assets tab and one PROPOSALS frame of the Features tab per asset of `assets`; `index.html` carrying the host element, not the parts; no provider or ticker named in a file of the module.
  - Exception: none

## Complexity

- `DASHBOARD-CONVENTIONS-A-TABLE-BUILDS-ITS-HEADER-BESIDE-ITS-ROWS`
  - Description: A table's header is built in the render function that emits its cells, so a column is one edit in one file.
  - Scope: `module_monitoring/**/*.js`, `module_monitoring/index.html`
  - Expected: `renderTable` or `appendHeaderRow` beside the rows, `index.html` carrying an empty `<thead>` for a table whose count it knows; a table per payload member built whole by `buildTable`, which makes its own `<thead>`, `index.html` carrying the host element instead.
  - Exception: none
